business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Port Container Gantry Cranes and Hoisting Gear

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid legal system based on civil law tradition (Napoleonic codes) with Islamic Sharia as the principal source of legislation and an independent administrative judiciary
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Arab Republic of Egypt and the People's Republic of China for the Promotion and Protection of Investments
Agreement between the Arab Republic of Egypt and the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income
Euro-Mediterranean Association Agreement between Egypt and the European Union
Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA) Investment Agreement
Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital in the Arab Countries

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 44 of 2016; Executive Regulations of the AML Law issued by the Central Bank of Egypt; Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority AML/CFT and Ultimate Beneficial Owner rules; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended; Law No. 72 of 2017 on Investment; GAFI beneficial ownership disclosure instructions; oversight by the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder, if any
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry or other competent authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization: attestation by the home-country ministry of foreign affairs followed by legalization by the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate; the Hague Apostille is not accepted for Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution or corporate action approving the incorporation of the Egyptian LLC and appointment of the local manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country board of directors or equivalent corporate body, duly notarized
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization: notarial certification abroad plus Egyptian consulate legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney in favor of the Egyptian attorney-at-law or GAFI incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Notary Public or home-country notary if executed abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in Egypt, or notarization abroad followed by Egyptian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of residential address of all shareholders, UBOs, directors and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority, home-country government office, bank or certified public official
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified copies attested by Egyptian consulate or Egyptian notary public, followed by sworn Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration and AML self-declaration form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each ultimate beneficial owner and authorized representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signed before an Egyptian notary public; if executed abroad, signature authenticated by Egyptian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-funds letter and bank reference letter for pre-incorporation capital transfers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized by the bank and legalized by Egyptian consulate if issued outside Egypt; Arabic sworn translation required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, managers, authorized signatories and persons exercising control against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Egyptian EMLCU and Central Bank of Egypt terrorist and financing watchlists, and Egypt's domestic CFT designations. PEPs, their family members and close associates require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, and senior-management approval. Refresher screening is required at least every six months for high-risk relationships and immediately upon any sanctions list update. AML/CFT and UBO records must be retained for at least five years after termination of the relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) digital one-stop-shop through 'Invest in Egypt' portal and the Egyptian Commercial Registry (Ministry of Trade and Industry) name-search module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The LLC's legal name must be in Arabic script and must be the governing registered identity. An English transliteration is accepted for foreign correspondence and bilingual GAFI forms, but it must be a faithful transliteration of the Arabic name. Foreign-language names cannot serve as the sole registered name without a corresponding Arabic name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Insurance, Financial or Credit Institution terms requiring Central Bank of Egypt or Financial Regulatory Authority licensing
Ministry, Governorate, Public Authority, or other government entity names
Police, Army, Armed Forces, National Guard, Presidency, Intelligence or military references
Religious, denominational, or religiously sensitive expressions, including Islamic or Christian references without ministerial authorization
Misr, Egyptian, or Arab Republic of Egypt used as a prefix without prior Cabinet or ministerial authorization
Names of living public figures, foreign states, heads of state, or unauthorized third-party personal names
Terms implying false commercial capacity, terrorist associations, public-sector sponsorship, or misleading activity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A GAFI name reservation may be extended for a similar period by filing an electronic extension application before expiry of the reserved name. If the proposed name is rejected, GAFI issues a written statement of reasons. The applicant may file a written administrative appeal or grievance through the GAFI one-stop-shop within 30 days from rejection, attaching the rejection notice, corrected legal justification, and a list of alternative names. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may initiate judicial review before the competent Egyptian administrative court. Incorporation may proceed under a different approved name while the appeal is unresolved.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole registered office. The LLC must maintain a physical, operational and accessible office in Egypt and, for the manufacture of port container gantry cranes and hoisting gear, an industrial facility with a valid lease or ownership title. A virtual office may be used only as an additional communications address and cannot replace the registered office for legal service, tax notices, or commercial registry registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: approximately 75% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months after registration. GAFI, Commercial Registry inspectors, labor and social insurance authorities, industrial licensing authorities, environmental inspectors and the Egyptian Tax Authority each retain the right to conduct on-site verification. Site visits are particularly common for industrial manufacturing premises such as crane and hoisting equipment plants.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI company name clearance and name reservation fee
Incorporation filing and Commercial Registry registration certificate fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of LLC memorandum of association and articles in Arabic
Publication of incorporation abstract in Al-Waqa'i' Al-Misriyya (Egyptian Official Gazette)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Official Gazette / Government Printing Office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration, tax ID file opening and VAT/economic activity certificate
Consular legalization of foreign parent documents, Arabic certified translation and notarization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Embassy/Consulate, accredited translator and notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular tariff and prevailing market translation rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO disclosure and AML/CFT KYC file preparation including PEP, OFAC, UN, EU and Egyptian watchlist screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance attorney or AML consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market professional fee, flat or hourly

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Full pre-incorporation legal due diligence and incorporation filing retainer by licensed Egyptian law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark flat fee for mid-size LLC formation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Industrial activity registration with the General Authority for Industrial Development and GAFI zoning/pre-licensing compliance review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Industrial Development / GAFI / technical consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulatory application fee plus consultant fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office lease prepayment for three months and lease contract notarization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark rent for industrial office and plant premises near port operations

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended), Articles 68-89 (limited liability companies) together with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations; Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 for manufacturing permits.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – One-Stop Shop for Company Formation; Ministry of Trade and Industry – Commercial Registration Office for the final commercial register entry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: LLC Incorporation Application through GAFI e-Portal, accompanied by the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (Contract of Incorporation) and registered with the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Companies Law No. 159/1981; shareholders are free to set capital, which must be bank-deposited to obtain an escrow-style bank certificate. For industrial licensing, the Industrial Development Authority requires declared capital sufficient for planned machinery and operating cost.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WHEREAS the incorporators have subscribed to the share capital of the LLC as provided in the Articles of Association; NOW THEREFORE, by unanimous written consent, it is RESOLVED that: (1) the share subscriptions are ratified and the founders' capital contributions are irrevocably allotted as per Exhibit A; (2) the registered office shall be [Insert Address], Egypt, designated as the official seat for legal and fiscal notices; (3) [Name] is appointed Managing Director and [Name] is appointed Company Secretary, jointly authorised to file commercial registration, obtain tax cards, and execute binding contracts; and (4) each officer is granted authority to open bank accounts and sign statutory declarations. RESOLVED FURTHER that this resolution becomes effective immediately upon execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Notarized Articles Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones) – Business Facilitation Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three possible Arabic names via the GAFI e-portal; after clearance, retain certified Arabic legal counsel to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association. Execute and notarize the Articles before an Egyptian Notary Public or GAFI attestation officer.
required_dossiers: Unified tax ID of subscribers if Egyptian resident
Proof of authority for corporate subscribers
Lease or usufruct deed for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is refused due to similarity, resubmit alternative names within 15 days; if the draft is queried by the GAFI reviewer, amend the relevant clauses and resubmit in the same session.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Temporary Capital Deposit Account and Bank Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian licensed bank operating under Central Bank of Egypt rules (e.g., NBE, CIB, HDB)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow-style account in the LLC's name at a licensed Egyptian bank using the draft Articles and name reservation; deposit subscribed capital in EGP or foreign currency; obtain a bank certificate confirming payment and source of funds.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the application due to missing endorsements, arrange notarization and have the Managing Director sign before the bank compliance officer; provide Anti-Money Laundering statements if requested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Dossier to GAFI One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI – Investor Services Centre (Companies and Commercial Registration Directorate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete package via the GAFI electronic portal and then physically deposit at the one-stop shop. Obtain stamped clearance, pay registration fees, and collect the Preliminary Incorporation Certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association (MOA and AOA)
Registered office lease or title deed
Form I for tax and commercial registration
Power of attorney for the signatory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI asks for clarifications, respond within 30 days through the same portal summarizing corrections; if the application is suspended, submit an administrative grievance to GAFI's Complaint Resolution Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Register Entry and Tax Card Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry – Commercial Registration Office; Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After GAFI approval, file for human, non-human, and domain commercial registrations at the local commercial registration office; attach the GAFI certificate; then apply at the ETA for the Income Tax Card, VAT registration, and payroll tax numbers.
required_dossiers: Board resolution appointing general manager and accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the commercial register queries incomplete leases, obtain a balanced lease certificate from the relevant municipality; for tax disputes, file with the ETA within 30 days using the standard complaint form.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial Licensing Application with IDA and Civil Defense
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) – Industrial Licenses Directorate; Ministry of Interior – Civil Defense Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the industrial project file including land, layout, equipment list, and CRC drawings via the IDA online platform; simultaneously apply to Civil Defense for fire clearance. If the project triggers EIA, provide the EEAA approval before obtaining the final operating license.
required_dossiers: Manufacturing process description and equipment list
Environmental Impact Assessment certificate, when applicable
Civil Defense fire evacuation and suppression plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If IDA rejects due to buffer-zone violation, request a location-review committee; if Civil Defense raises fire extinguisher coverage deficiencies, amend the site plan and resubmit within 10 working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) of the Ministry of Trade and Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Facility Operating License issued under Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 (recognizing the manufacture of overhead cranes and gantry equipment)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Environmental Impact Assessment Directorate
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report (Category C) required due to heavy metal fabrication, welding, painting, and testing processes associated with gantry crane manufacturing
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 48/1982 (Nile water standards) and its Executive Regulations for wastewater discharge; limits for heavy metals including iron, manganese, copper, and lead; VOC emissions from painting and solvent operations must meet the air quality standards of Prime Ministerial Decree No. 76/2000; hazardous waste handling must meet the conditions of Law No. 4/1994, including the National Industrial Emissions Register reporting obligations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Civil Defense Authority (Ministry of Interior), structural load inspection certificate from the local municipality engineering directorate, and occupational safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12/2003; testing and certification of load-bearing capacity for all overhead cranes and gantry equipment is mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; unified e-government tax portal 'Ingez' at https://tax.gov.eg; e-invoicing platform at https://einvoice.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Egyptian LLC: (1) Notarize articles of association and obtain incorporation and commercial registration from the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI); (2) After commercial registration, file the unified tax registration application with the ETA via the Ingez portal or in-person service center; (3) Attach the formation contract, commercial register extract, passport or foreign corporate certificate of the shareholders, board resolution, and registered office lease; (4) ETA issues the unified Tax Card and the statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) covering income tax, VAT, and stamp taxes; (5) Appoint a resident legal representative and a licensed tax accountant to act as tax domicile for filings and service of notices. Standard processing time is 5 to 10 business days after GAFI final approval.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The Egyptian LLC is a non-transparent corporate taxpayer subject to corporate income tax at 22.5% under Law No. 91 of 2005; no pass-through or check-the-box election exists. Available elections: (a) consolidated CIT grouping for Egyptian companies with at least 90% common ownership (Article 60 of Law 91/2005, subject to ETA approval); (b) voluntary VAT registration at an annual turnover of EGP 250,000 below the mandatory EGP 500,000 threshold; (c) tax stabilization agreement under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 allowing fixation of tax rates and exemptions for up to 10 years; (d) actual-margin versus deemed-margin computation for any permanent establishment characterization.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended, and Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2588 of 2016)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: annual taxable supplies of goods and services equal to or exceeding EGP 500,000; voluntary registration available from EGP 250,000 annual turnover; threshold assessed on gross taxable turnover excluding exempt supplies
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory near-real-time fiscal reporting regime: all registered VAT payers must document B2B supplies through the ETA e-invoicing system (Ministerial Decree No. 113 of 2020) using certified billing software integrated to the ETA via REST API; XML or JSON invoice files are submitted to the central ETA platform, automatically validated against taxpayer master data and transactional business rules, and an acceptance certificate with a unique validation code and QR digital stamp is returned for printing and transmission to the buyer; invoices failing validation are rejected and the underlying sale is non-compliant. The e-receipt (RTC) system extends the same fiscal clearance mechanism to B2C sales. Non-integration or non-submission triggers blockage of the trader's e-invoicing portal access and substantial administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating at 0% VAT applies under Article 19 of Law 67/2016 and Article 49 of the Executive Regulations to: (i) goods physically exported from Egypt under customs control by the VAT-registered exporter, including port container gantry and overhead cranes; (ii) transport, handling, and ancillary services directly connected to the export shipment; and (iii) services performed from Egypt for a non-resident wholly for use in the non-resident's business outside Egypt. The claim is available only to the registered exporter named as a consignor in the customs documentation; domestic supply, installation, and commissioning of machinery within Egypt remain taxable at 14%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (single administrative document) duly released and stamped by the Egyptian Customs Authority
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical dispatch of the cranes and gantry equipment from an Egyptian port
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian licensed bank confirming receipt of the export proceeds in foreign currency
Sales contract, final commercial invoice, and Central Bank of Egypt export registration form
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA applies targeted audit scrutiny to export zero-rating claims and cross-matches customs release data, bill of lading records, and bank remittance certificates. If the physical export is not completed or the proceeds are not received in and repatriated through the Egyptian banking system within the CBE-standard deadline of 180 days (extendable only by CBE approval), VAT at 14% is retroactively assessed on the invoice value with a delay surcharge of 2% per month or part thereof under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 73 of 2021. Fraudulent zero-rating claims, including false export declarations, fictitious remittances, round-tripping of goods, or diversion of goods to the domestic market, trigger criminal tax evasion prosecution with fines of up to 100% of the evaded tax plus imprisonment, and cancellation of the taxpayer's VAT registration and e-invoicing license.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a managed floating exchange rate with partial capital account convertibility. Current account transactions, including merchandise trade and service payments, are generally convertible upon submission of supporting documentation. Capital account transactions, such as equity contributions and intercompany loans, require prior CBE approval and are subject to repatriation controls. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted but subject to CBE review, potential surrender obligations, and withholding tax compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egyptian exporters must surrender 100% of foreign currency export proceeds to an authorized bank within six months of collection. Surrender is mandatory for all export receipts, supported by commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading. Delays beyond six months require CBE justification and may attract penalties. For overhead crane and gantry crane exports, proceeds must be converted and surrendered in full to maintain regulatory compliance and avoid forex allocation restrictions.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Fintech EMI cross-border viability is low. Egyptian LLCs are prohibited from using unlicensed offshore digital payment platforms under CBE regulations. All cross-border transactions must route exclusively through licensed Egyptian commercial banks; offshore EMIs are not permitted absent specific CBE exemptions, which are rarely granted for manufacturing entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners must appear physically for KYC interviews and account opening at Egyptian commercial banks. Remote account opening is not permitted for standard Egyptian LLC structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership or source of funds inconsistencies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit notarized ownership certificates, passport copies, corporate resolutions, and detailed source-of-funds statements to substantiate beneficial ownership and resolve any discrepancies.
Provide bank references, transaction histories, legal opinions confirming clean status, and proof of no sanctions or adverse media connections.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital from foreign investors must be routed via SWIFT MT103 using purpose code 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' or 'EQUITY INVESTMENT'. All transactions require prior CBE approval for foreign exchange allocation. Verification includes investment agreements, board resolutions, and proof of funds origin.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for crane exports utilize SWIFT MT103 for payments against commercial invoices or Documentary Letters of Credit (LCs) under UCP 600. Project-related settlements may utilize Project Escrow accounts with banks such as CIB or NBE. All LCs must be confirmed by Egyptian banks and accompanied by full commercial documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward FX contracts for hedging export receivables
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for long-term exposure management
Currency swaps to manage multi-currency exposures in trade finance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: April 30 following the fiscal year-end (within 4 months after the close of the tax period; calendar-year default)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing procedural fine under Unified Tax Law No. 90 of 2021 plus 2% additional tax per month on the unpaid liability; administrative collection and suspension of tax clearance certificate impacting customs and public procurement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements and Annual General Assembly Report filed with Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual General Assembly to approve financial statements within 6 months of fiscal year-end (by June 30 for calendar-year companies); GAFI filing of audited financial statements and auditor's report within 15 days of assembly approval (typically by July 15)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative warning then financial penalties under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; failure to file for two consecutive years exposes the LLC to administrative strike-off from the Commercial Register and judicial dissolution; directors may incur personal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry (MOTI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During January of each calendar year in accordance with the company's commercial registration certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late fine of EGP 100 plus reinstatement fees; suspended commercial registration blocks the company from lawful commercial activity and banking operations until renewal is completed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the same statutory period as the financial statements (by June 30 for calendar-year companies); any ownership or UBO change must be filed within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory administrative fine up to EGP 1,000,000 for inaccurate, incomplete, or omitted UBO disclosure under Law No. 4 of 2022 and Ministerial Decree No. 33 of 2022; GAFI suspends all registry services (share transfers, director appointments, amendments) until compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Limited Liability Companies incorporated under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 must appoint at least one certified auditor registered with the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) and file audited financial statements with GAFI, with no size, turnover, or asset-based exemption for LLC status; audit is also mandatory for corporate income tax purposes under Unified Tax Law No. 90 of 2021.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Financial Reporting Standards (EFRS), issued by the Ministry of Investment and substantially converged with IFRS; EFRS constitutes the local GAAP for statutory financial statements of all Egyptian companies, including industrial manufacturers of port lifting equipment.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 4 of 2022 and Ministerial Decree No. 33 of 2022, each LLC must maintain a current UBO register and file an annual confirmation with GAFI alongside the annual financial statement submission. Any transfer of quota shares, including transfers to non-resident shareholders, must be recorded in the register and reported to GAFI within 30 days; changes to controlling ownership also require prior GAFI approval before registration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Book of Managerial Resolutions and Related-Party Contracts

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Egyptian tax law provides no general statutory tax holiday; however, companies in the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) may benefit from a 0% or reduced corporate income tax rate on qualifying activities for up to 5 years under the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, subject to the issuance of a Golden License and approval of the SCZone Authority. Manufacturing companies engaged in capital-intensive industries such as port equipment may qualify for an investment tax deduction of up to 30% of the investment cost in certain new industrial projects under Law 72/2017. No general preferential deduction for overhead crane manufacturing is otherwise available outside specific SCZone incentives.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Tax Form No. 2 (Return for Legal Persons) filed electronically via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal at https://www.incometax.gov.eg / https://eticket.eta.gov.eg, or through an ETA-authorized tax intermediary.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual corporate tax return must be filed within four months from the end of the fiscal year. For a December 31 fiscal year-end, the filing deadline is April 30 of the following year. Companies operating in a fiscal year other than the calendar year must file by the last day of the fourth month following their financial statement date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Name and Commercial Registration No.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the LLC as per commercial registry, tax card number, and file number of the Egyptian Tax Authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an Egypt-registered LLC, the name must be the entity's Egyptian legal name. If the parent is a foreign company, the local branch or subsidiary should list its own registered name under the Egyptian Commercial Registry.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique 10-digit tax registration number issued by the ETA, including the block/tax office code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not file this return on their own; the Egyptian LLC must use its own TIN. A foreign entity without a permanent establishment in Egypt does not file Form No. 2.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Legal Form and Industry Activity Code
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select Limited Liability Company (LLC) and the relevant ISIC/economic activity code (ISIC 2816 for manufacture of lifting and handling equipment).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include the exact ISIC 2816 and a brief factual description: manufacture of port container gantry cranes and hoisting gear. No import of foreign classification codes into this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 – Balance Sheet Date / Fiscal Year End
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State the fiscal year end used for statutory accounts (typically 31/12).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fiscal year end must match the Egyptian GAAP (or IFRS as accepted by ETA) audited financial statements. No separate reporting period should be adopted for the non-resident parent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total turnover from sale of overhead cranes, gantry cranes, hoisting gear, spare parts, and after-sales services, net of discounts and returns, derived from the certified income statement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All revenues derived from contracts performed in Egypt must be reported. Export revenues from the SCZone must be segregated and identified to the correct incentive code, supported by customs export declarations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 – Cost of Goods Sold and Direct Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of raw materials, imported components, direct labor, factory overhead depreciation, and production expenses attributable to the crane manufacturing operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany purchases from the non-resident parent must be disclosed at arm's length. The field should be supported by transfer pricing documentation and a summary schedule of related-party transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General overhead expenses, management fees, licenses, insurance, local taxes, and administrative salaries.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any head-office charges allocated from the foreign parent must be supported by service agreements and the arm's length standard. Non-deductible expenses must be separately added back in the reconciliation schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax depreciation on fixed assets and amortization of intangible assets computed according to Egyptian tax rules or in conformity with ETA-approved tax depreciation tables.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Depreciation of cranes supplied to Egyptian port operators should follow the ETA asset class guidance. For assets sourced from the related party, depreciation basis must be the arm's length cost recorded under the Egyptian purchase invoice.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 – Adjusted Accounting Profit / Taxable Income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net profit before tax adjusted by permanent and temporary differences (e.g., disallowed provisioning, impairment, non-deductible interest in excess of thin-capitalization limits, donations without qualifying receipts).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC must reconcile IFRS/GAAP profit to tax profit using the statutory reconciliation statements. The parent cannot unilaterally adjust the Egyptian taxable base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 – Tax Credits, Prepaid Taxes, and Withholding Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for preliminary tax installments, income tax withheld at source by Egyptian customers on project payments, and foreign tax credits if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC may claim a foreign tax credit for withholding or corporate taxes paid in the non-resident parent's jurisdiction only to the extent Egypt has a relevant tax treaty and only against the Egyptian tax on the same income. Due documentation includes an ETA-approved tax invoice and withholding tax certificates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 11 – Total Tax Due / Net Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The final corporate income tax liability after applying credits and any advance payments, i.e., taxable income x 22.5% less installments and credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any remaining tax must be paid before or with filing to avoid late-payment interest of 2% per month. Annual installments paid by non-resident shareholders' loans or parent contributions are not deductible unless properly recorded as taxable capital funding.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: For late filing, a penalty of 10% of the total tax due is imposed, with a minimum of EGP 5,000. If the tax return is electronically delayed by more than 60 days without a valid justification, an additional penalty of up to EGP 50,000 may be levied under the ETA procedures. If no tax is due, a late filing penalty of EGP 3,000 can apply. Monthly late-payment interest on unpaid tax is 2% compounded monthly until full settlement. Incorrect or misleading statements in the return may attract a penalty from 30% up to 100% of the tax differential, and may constitute tax evasion under Law 91 of 2005.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Dividend distributions by an Egyptian LLC are subject to withholding tax at the statutory rate of 10% on the gross amount distributed in excess of the paid-up capital and reserves as calculated under the Egyptian tax framework. For an LLC owned by a non-resident parent, the company itself, as the distributing payer, must withhold and remit 10% to the Egyptian Tax Authority.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a double tax agreement (DTA) and reduce or exempt Egyptian dividend withholding, the non-resident shareholder must submit an advance application to the ETA using the official forms for treaty relief. The required protocol includes: (1) obtaining a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the shareholder's domestic tax authority for the relevant calendar year; (2) having the TRC certified by the competent authority of the shareholder's jurisdiction in accordance with the specific DTA administrative practice if not already apostilled; (3) completing the ETA's treaty relief application with full information on the Egyptian company name, ETA file number, ownership chain, percentage shareholding, and beneficial ownership statement; (4) providing the Egyptian LLC's board resolution approving the distribution and the notarized audited financial statements; (5) obtaining a written ETA approval letter specifying the reduced rate prior to distribution, where possible; and (6) retaining all underlying documents including dividend vouchers, bank transfer records, and the ETA clearance letter for at least five years. Agreements with relevant jurisdictions: Egypt has DTA protocols with most OECD and Arab countries. For an Egyptian LLC in the SCZone, the parent must demonstrate that it is the beneficial owner and that more than the required holding period (often 12 or 24 months) is satisfied if required by the respective treaty. If DTA relief is denied, the full 10% statutory WHT is due and cannot be refunded except through a formal objection or tax litigation before the tax courts.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to a non-resident for the use of intellectual property rights in Egypt are subject to a 20% withholding tax under Egyptian domestic law, unless reduced by an applicable treaty. For interest on debt paid to a non-resident, the domestic WHT rate is 20% as well. Many Egyptian DTAs reduce royalty and interest WHT to 10% or 15%; e.g., the Egypt-UK DTA reduces royalties to 15% and interest to 10%; Egypt-Germany DTA limits royalties to 10% and interest to 10%; Egypt-France DTA generally limits interest to 10% and royalties to 10% depending on the IP type and beneficial ownership. All reductions require the same treaty relief application protocol described above. Payments to non-resident related parties must also pass the arm's length and economic substance tests; excessive royalty payments may be recast as dividends and subject to the dividend withholding rate plus penalties.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Egyptian TP documentation thresholds under the ETA's transfer pricing decree (Decree No. 82 of 2020 and Law 91/2005 amended by Law 58/2021): The Local File must be maintained if the value of controlled transactions with Egyptian related parties exceeds EGP 10 million per fiscal year. The Master File must be prepared if the worldwide gross revenue of the multinational group exceeds EGP 2 billion and the Egyptian entity's related-party transactions in Egypt exceed EGP 10 million. For the Egyptian LLC manufacturing overhead cranes, typical controlled transactions include (i) purchase of steel and electrical components from related-party suppliers; (ii) license of crane design software or patented hoisting mechanisms; (iii) management, engineering support, and shared IT services received from the parent; and (iv) sales of cranes to related trading or port companies. A benchmarking study is required for each controlled transaction, using Egyptian or comparable regional comparables where available, or OECD-compliant international search if no local comparables exist.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt's economic substance doctrine is codified under tax law via anti-avoidance rules (Article 46 of Law 91/2005, amended by Law 58/2021). The ETA may disregard transactions or restructure arrangements that lack economic substance and whose sole or dominant purpose is obtaining a tax benefit. In specific free zones and the SCZone, the Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply indirectly as a general anti-abuse test for preferential tax treatment; a licensed SCZone entity deriving income from port crane manufacturing must demonstrate actual employees, physical equipment, risks control, and substantive decision-making in Egypt. The SCZone Authority and ETA can apply substance-over-form doctrine to re-characterize agency, financing, or asset use arrangements between the Egyptian LLC and non-resident parent. Additionally, for Egyptian entities receiving offshore loans, the interest deduction is disallowed to the extent that debt exceeds a 4:1 debt-to-equity ratio, aligning with thin capitalization rules. The LLC must retain board minutes, technical staff presence, production floor evidence, and project execution records to evidence substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately underreporting crane manufacturing revenues, issuing false invoices, destroying accounting records, booking non-deductible related-party expenses as genuine purchases, or concealing export income from the ETA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment from 3 to 5 years and a fine ranging from EGP 50,000 to EGP 1,000,000 (Law 91/2005, Articles 132 and 133). The tax authority may additionally impose after-tax penalties of up to 100% of the tax underpaid, plus monthly 2% late-payment interest. The court may order the publication of the conviction at the taxpayer's cost.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and managers who knowingly participate in tax evasion scheme are jointly solidarily liable for the unpaid tax, penalties, and fees. A conviction may also result in a travel ban, asset freeze, and disqualification from managing any company incorporated in Egypt for up to five years. If fraudulent trading is proven, courts may pierce the corporate veil and hold all directors personally liable for third-party port operator damages.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance in SCZone
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the SCZone LLC as a shell entity with no local management, no production staff, no manufacturing facility, no inventory handling, and only nominal invoicing to obtain the reduced tax rate and repatriate profits as royalties or management fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The SCZone Authority and ETA may withdraw the Golden License and tax incentives, and the company becomes subject to standard 22.5% corporate income tax on all profits retroactively. An anti-abuse penalty of up to 40% of the tax difference can be imposed, plus disqualification from future free-zone licensing in Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false reports declaring factory operations in the SCZone without actual operations are personally liable for the recovered incentive amounts. The Ministry of Investment and ETA may refer the matter to the Public Prosecutor; directors may face criminal fraud charges and a travel ban pending settlement or trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Overcharging imports of crane parts or undercharging export sales to the foreign parent; paying excessive royalties for ordinary design engineering; inflating management fees; maintaining an unjustifiably high debt-to-equity ratio exceeding 4:1 and charging excessive interest to the Egyptian LLC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The ETA may make a transfer pricing adjustment to the taxable income, recompute the corporate tax, and impose additional tax plus interest of 2% per month on the deficiency. A penalty of up to 30% of the adjusted portion can be levied if the taxpayer has failed to submit timely transfer pricing documentation. The full amount must be paid within 60 days of final assessment; otherwise an enforcement order is issued against the company's movable assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approved the inflated intercompany agreements in the absence of any independent benchmarking study may be held personally liable to the company for the amount of tax loss if the tax authority collects the deficiency from the company. The ETA may also pursue directors for criminal misstatement if they certified false documents to banks or port authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / AML (using port crane project payments)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting cash kickbacks in connection with a port equipment tender, routing proceeds through the Egyptian LLC without commercial justification, mixing project escrow funds with personal accounts, or failing to report suspicious transactions related to cross-border crane sales under Egyptian AML Law No. 80 of 2002.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment for up to 7 years and a fine from EGP 100,000 to EGP 500,000 for intentional money laundering of funds derived from a criminal activity. The entity is subject to winding-up and forfeiture of the laundered funds and the instruments or assets connected to the offense. The relevant supervisory authority may also permanently close the company's Egyptian bank accounts and impose non-refundable penalties of up to 20% of the transaction value on non-compliant institutions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Every director and senior officer is personally liable for failing to implement adequate anti-money-laundering compliance controls, independent of company liability. Courts have imposed travel bans and seizure of personal property where directors signed off on payment instructions on behalf of a shell company with no economic substance. Serious cases may result in imprisonment of the directors themselves.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold Dividend WHT / Treaty Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing profits to the non-resident parent without deducting the 10% WHT; failing to obtain the ETA treaty clearance before applying the reduced DTA rate; paying dividends to an intermediary shell entity that is not the beneficial owner solely to avoid WHT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Egyptian LLC as withholding agent is liable for the unwithheld 10% dividend tax, in addition to a 100% penalty on the withheld amount: i.e., a total of 20% of the distribution may be collected. Article 115 of Law 91/2005 requires the company to calculate the withholding correctly and remit within the statutory period; failure triggers an additional 2% monthly penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the company's tax representative are personally liable for the unpaid withholding amount if the company is dissolved or becomes insolvent before settlement. Directors who knowingly used a shell intermediary to evade dividend WHT may face criminal tax evasion charges with up to 5 years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Maintain Transfer Pricing Documentation (Local / Master File)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exceeding the EGP 10 million controlled transaction threshold and not preparing the Local File; or being part of a group with over EGP 2 billion global revenue and exceeding the EGP 10 million threshold but not preparing the Master File; failing to submit within 30 days upon ETA request or providing incomplete comparability analyses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A fixed penalty of EGP 100,000 for failure to maintain transfer pricing documentation plus an additional EGP 100,000 penalty for failure to submit the file within the specified period (total up to EGP 200,000). The tax authority may disregard the taxpayer's sales data and estimate taxable profit using a deemed markup derived from any available comparable. The ETA may impose a 30% penalty on any favorable TP adjustment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed the tax return and attested that TP documentation was prepared when no valid file actually exists risk a conviction for false attestation before the Egyptian tax prosecution. If the penalty is collected from the company and the company has insufficient assets, the directors who approved the missing documents may be sued in civil court for damages resulting from the penalty.
